Autozone Intelligence Data Pipeline

End-to-end ingestion, deduplication, dialect NLP and compliance safeguards
Step 01
Multi-Source Ingestion
Real-time webhook and streaming API connectors polling Snapchat, Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube, Haraj and Google Maps.
Step 02
Entity Disambiguation
Distinguishes Balubaid Autozone KSA from unrelated US/international entities using location geofencing & branch tagging.
Step 03
Saudi Dialect NLP
Custom BERT model trained on Najdi, Hijazi & Eastern Saudi slang for 94.8% sentiment and intent classification precision.
Step 04
Human Verification
Critical customer escalations flagged into Balubaid CRM queue with 30-minute SLA for social care teams.
Step 05
Executive Reporting
Automated ingestion into BigQuery analytical warehouse feeding leadership dashboards and operations reviews.

Saudi Data Sovereignty & Compliance Standards

All customer verbatims are processed under Saudi Arabia Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL). Personal Identifiable Information (PII) such as national IDs, phone numbers, and vehicle license plate numbers are hashed and anonymized prior to storage in local cloud instances.
